not_found.searched: Thai-language and English searches for 2025/2026 honey (น้ำผึ้ง) exports, production and prices: Ministry of Commerce TPSO trade releases, Department of Livestock Development, OPSMOAC, The Nation, Thai press
not_found.result: No 2025 or 2026 national honey figure found. Latest is 2024 bee-product exports of 7,311.88 t / THB 621.43 million (The Nation, citing Thai authorities, broader than honey) and 2024 ITC/WITS-based values; nothing for 2025 production or prices.

note_it: Dati trovati sul web, ciascuno verificato da Paladex sulla pagina che cita (la frase citata e il numero sono stati ritrovati sulla pagina). Non sono statistiche ufficiali e non vengono mai sommati ai dati ufficiali, alla mappa o ai confronti.
note_en: Figures found on the web, each checked by Paladex on the page it cites (the quoted sentence and the number were found on that page). They are not official statistics and are never added to the official figures, the map or the comparisons.
